scope: Bounded §7.4.4.4/Tables8–10 source and assertion review, not whole filter-family certification.
source: Effective ISO PDF printed41–42; PNG 2003 §9.2 byte reconstruction; source-local errata index has no identified §7.4.4.4 amendment.

features.feature: Predictor selection/defaults and per-row PNG tags
features.assertions: flate_lzw_spec_audit table8_defaults_and_png_row_tags_reach_both_decoders: no prediction default, omitted Colors/BPC/Columns defaults, mixed tags under Predictor10 for both filters; filters each_png_row_carries_its_own_filter_type checks None/Sub/Up/Average; Paeth test independently exercises each neighbor answer.
features.verdict: Discriminating literal output assertions, not decoder/encoder round trips. PNG selection values10–15 share path, but no exhaustive six-value matrix claimed.

features.feature: TIFF component arithmetic and PNG byte arithmetic
features.assertions: Existing TIFF8 multiro w, TIFF16 two-color carry and modulo wrap, TIFF2-bit padding/wrap literal outputs. New PNG16 RGB six-byte stride and packed2bit rows independently calculate outputs; both pass.
features.verdict: Source distinguishes arithmetic units explicitly. New tests discriminate wrong component carry, wrong color stride and cross-row carry. TIFF1/4-bit and all PNG filter/depth combinations remain pending.

features.assertions: Existing undefined predictor/depth refusal controls and trailing type byte recovery have exact output/presence checks.
features.verdict: Malformed-input policy evidence, not mandatory ISO rejection or universal conformance. Preserve distinction from valid feature controls.

execution: predictors-wave11.log16/16PASS includes filters, prior Flate/LZW defaults and full-table reset tests. Execution of LZW reset does not constitute renewed complete §7.4.4.2 review.
